title: Quantifying gender biases towards politicians on Reddit

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating extra-linguistic cues (coverage volume, comment length, and combinatorial gender assortativity) and linguistic cues (nominal biases in naming conventions, sentiment and dominance analysis using the NRC VAD Lexicon and a RoBERTa classifier, and lexical biases using Pointwise Mutual Information to extract and manually categorize gender-associated descriptors).
